name: compass-rose
description: Compass Rose: a workbench and methodology that connects Codebase-Cartographer, ClauDHD, and Gantry into one idea-to-implementation pipeline for Claude Code.

plugins.name: compass
plugins.description: The connective layer over Codebase-Cartographer (the chart), ClauDHD (dead reckoning), and Gantry (the dock): map-grounded design, a roadmap that is the hub, a two-lane triage with a capped quick-fixes batch, and a unified session brief. Orchestrates the three instruments; does not replace them.
